title: Polynomial-time computation of header fields
statement: For every fixed natural number $j$, the function that maps a Boolean word encoding a nested-pair header to its $j$-th field, returning the empty word when the parsing or field selection is undefined, is polynomial-time computable.
hypotheses_covered: Input is a Boolean word encoding a nested-pair header
Polynomial-time computability with all scans charged
replaced: For every fixed count $j$, the function taking an encoded header to its $j$-th field is polynomial-time computable, with all projections charged.
